orientation.description: Thirty-four selected main spatial rows clockwise90, including a narrow right-hand continuation beside the image, plus four native closing rows. Dark flower/leaf areas reduce contour contrast. Row joins and intended reading order are provisional. Upper caps on r-like bases are conditional, with detached-mark alternatives; ordinary date-like writing excluded.
orientation.coordinate_convention: xyxy continuous image-edge coordinates. Native→CW90: (x,y)→(1175-y,x); native→CW270: (x,y)→(y,1785-x); native→CW180: (x,y)→(1785-x,1175-y). Bounds are broad whole-block context, not exact rows or physical bodies.
